about: Trade intel the opposing GMs use: who is on the block, what each club is looking for, who is shedding salary. status: available = actively shopped; listening = open to offers; untouchable = reported off-limits. Master copy lives in the public repo; a daily task refreshes it from MLB Trade Rumors, MLB.com and The Athletic reporting.

WSN.note: Rebuilding under Paul Toboni; pitching is the need

KCR.note: Wants starting pitching or a right-handed-hitting outfielder; Pasquantino move opens 1B for Caglianone

MIN.note: Listening on Joe Ryan for catching, 1B/DH and bullpen help

CHW.note: Cholowsky coming at SS; wants pitching

CHC.note: Would move Matt Shaw to get pitching

BAL.note: Pursuing Ketel Marte; Holliday is the value in that conversation

SEA.note: Kirby talks are about filling lineup holes

players.name: CJ Abrams

players.name: Jackson Holliday
players.note: Value in a Ketel Marte deal
